description: Rule-driven DRS review UI, WICKET-DRIVEN to match LBW_Full_Matrix.xlsx exactly. For each ball the renderer reads the gate values (delivery / pitching / impact / wicket / height), walks the rules top-to-bottom, and applies the FIRST rule whose `when` matches. Edit these rules to change what the review shows — no code, no rebuild. See docs/DRS_Rules_Master_Table.md.

_howMatchingWorks.PRESENT: matches when the ball's value was evaluated (NOT N/A)
_howMatchingWorks.NA: matches when the ball's value is N/A (never evaluated)
_howMatchingWorks.[list]: matches when the ball's value is one of the list
_howMatchingWorks.VALUE: matches when the ball's value equals it exactly (e.g. OUTSIDE_OFF)

_layout: Panels are placed with TWO explicit lists: panelsLeft (left column) and panelsRight (right column). Put a panel name in whichever side you want; use [] for a side with no panels. panelsRight: list order = TOP-to-bottom on screen. panelsLeft: list order = BOTTOM-to-top on screen (the LEFT column builds bottom-up to follow the trajectory — first entry sits lowest, so author it in reveal order: pitching, impact, wickets = pitching at the bottom).

rules.label: Full toss (3.4.7) — would have pitched; line only, umpire judges height
Full toss — wicket evaluated → full trajectory (top-down)
Full toss — struck outside line → stop at pad (top-down)
Pitched outside leg — no trajectory; top-down zoom to the bounce
rules.note: Gate 1 absolute stop (checked FIRST). No trajectory. Camera moves top-down to the bounce. LEFT: Original Decision + Pitching. RIGHT: Final Decision + Player Review.

rules.label: Pitched — wicket evaluated → FULL trajectory to the stumps
rules.note: Covers impact In Line, Umpire's Call, AND impact-outside-off with the wicket shown.

rules.label: Pitched — struck outside the line, wicket not checked → STOP at pad
Pitched — nothing else matched → pitch only
